notes: the chain field «أبو النعمان انا حماد ابن يزيد, ثابت» is read as names; «انا» is the transmission verb (أنبأنا) and is left out of the names
the matn's speaker, Anas (خدمت رسول الله), is not named in the field, so no Companion is added
«أبو النعمان» is kept as a bare kunya and not identified
